title: The Chalkbone Greaves
summary: Something to wear out of the Rings, legs to go with the rest of the set.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now work a chalkbone bar and a pair of hollow teeth into greaves, to go with the cleaver, the plate and the gauntlets.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking hollow teeth, for anyone who would rather buy than dig one out of whatever grew it.

items.name: Chalkbone greaves
items.examine: Plated down the shin in chalkbone, backed with teeth that already knew how to hold an edge.
